<div class="ds-summary">
  <h3>How the sources fit together</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Primary:</strong> Ministry of Health master facility registries — one per country, above.</li>
    <li><strong>Cross-reference:</strong> OpenStreetMap facility tags, used only to validate coordinates and flag likely coverage gaps. Never overrides the MoH record.</li>
    <li><strong>Not used:</strong> commercial listings, aggregators, or crowdsourced portals that don't disclose their upstream source.</li>
  </ul>
  <p style="color: #666; margin: 1rem 0 0;">All eight sources are refreshed on a rolling basis; see the <a href="about.html">About page</a> for the ETL cadence.</p>
</div>

<div class="ds-method">
  <h2>Data Harmonization Methodology</h2>
  <p>
    All source datasets are harmonised to a common schema: unique facility ID, official name,
    administrative hierarchy (country / region / district), facility type (hospital / clinic /
    health centre), ownership (public / private / faith-based / NGO), GPS coordinates,
    operational status, last-verification date, and service availability indicators.
    Quality assessment includes duplicate detection, coordinate validation against the
    country bounding box, admin-hierarchy consistency checks, and temporal completeness.
  </p>
</div>
